newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan monetary policy should be flexible - MITI.
newsitem.headline: Japan monetary policy should be flexible - MITI.

text.p: Japan's monetary policy needs to be managed flexibly, Vice Trade Minister Tsutomu Makino told reporters on Monday.

He said it was not his place to say when a rate increase was necessary, but speaking in general terms, as Japan could no longer rely on fiscal stimulus measures to support economic recovery, it was important that monetary policy be managed flexibly.

He also said that the economy was recovering gradually and had shown good growth in the January-to-March period due to a rush in consumer spending ahead of the April 1 increase in the sales tax, but "private demand is not necessarily robust".

He said this reflected the fact that capital spending and consumption, although firmer than the previous year, were not as strong as they could be. He added that it was necessary to keep a close watch on these areas.
